    maxRetries: 5
    baseDelayMs: 5000

questions.cancelled: User declined to answer the questions. Continue with the task using your best judgment, or ask different questions.

plan.declinedEntry: User declined to enter plan mode.
plan.editGate: Rejected: file edits are not allowed in plan mode - the only editable file is the plan file (/.grok/plan.md).
plan.revision:
The user wants to revise the plan. The user said:
Add rollback steps
plan.emptyExit: Plan mode exit approved. No plan content was found — you can proceed.
plan.abandoned: The user chose to abandon the plan entirely (via the Abandon option in the plan approval dialog). Plan mode has been disabled. Do not call exit_plan_mode again unless the user explicitly asks to re-enter plan mode.
plan.resumed: The user approved the plan. Implement the plan in plan.md.

noArgs.message: No research query was provided. Run /deep-research <query>, or pass args.query.
